# Population Distribution Across Baseline Travel-Time Bands (Figure 2)

## Load libraries
```{r}
library(terra)
library(here)
```

## Load population raster
```{r}
# Auto-detect population raster from the processed Worldpop folder
pop_dir <- here("Data", "processed", "Worldpop_density")
pop_files <- list.files(pop_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)

# Prefer the file whose name contains "pop_total"; fall back to first .tif
pop_file <- pop_files[grepl("pop_total", pop_files, ignore.case = TRUE)]
if (length(pop_file) == 0) pop_file <- pop_files[1]

pop_rast <- rast(pop_file)
cat("Population raster loaded:", basename(pop_file), "\n")
cat("  CRS :", crs(pop_rast, describe = TRUE)$name, "\n")
cat("  Res :", res(pop_rast), "\n")
```

## Align population raster to travel-time grid
```{r}
# Project and resample population raster to match base_tt_all grid
# (CRS, extent, and resolution). Uses bilinear interpolation for continuous
# population counts.
if (!compareGeom(pop_rast, base_tt_all, stopOnError = FALSE)) {
  cat("Aligning population raster to travel-time grid...\n")
  pop_aligned <- project(pop_rast, base_tt_all, method = "bilinear")
} else {
  cat("Population raster already aligned.\n")
  pop_aligned <- pop_rast
}

# Mask population to the same valid-data extent as the travel-time raster
pop_aligned <- mask(pop_aligned, base_tt_all)

# Print total population in the study extent
total_pop <- global(pop_aligned, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)[[1]]
cat("Total population in study extent:", format(round(total_pop), big.mark = ","), "\n")
```

## Define travel-time breaks (Figure 2)
```{r}
tt_breaks <- c(0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120, 180, Inf)

# Human-readable band labels
tt_labels <- c("0–15", "15–30", "30–45", "45–60",
               "60–90", "90–120", "120–180", ">180")
```

## Helper function: population by travel-time band
```{r}
pop_by_tt_band <- function(tt_rast, pop_rast, breaks, labels) {
  # Classify travel-time raster into integer band IDs (1, 2, …, n)
  rcl <- cbind(breaks[-length(breaks)], breaks[-1], seq_along(labels))
  tt_class <- classify(tt_rast, rcl, include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE)

  # Zonal sum of population within each band
  z <- zonal(pop_rast, tt_class, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)

  # Build tidy data frame
  names(z) <- c("band_id", "pop_count")
  z$band      <- labels[z$band_id]
  z$pop_count <- round(z$pop_count)

  total <- sum(z$pop_count, na.rm = TRUE)
  z$pct <- round(z$pop_count / total * 100, 2)

  # Return in band order
 z <- z[order(z$band_id), c("band", "pop_count", "pct")]
  rownames(z) <- NULL
  z
}
```

## Compute population distribution — All facilities
```{r}
tab_all <- pop_by_tt_band(base_tt_all, pop_aligned, tt_breaks, tt_labels)

cat("\n=== Baseline travel time to ALL facilities ===\n")
cat("Total population:", format(sum(tab_all$pop_count), big.mark = ","), "\n\n")
print(tab_all)
```

## Compute population distribution — Hospitals only
```{r}
# Align population to base_tt_hosp grid (should be identical, but safe to check)
if (!compareGeom(pop_aligned, base_tt_hosp, stopOnError = FALSE)) {
  pop_aligned_hosp <- project(pop_aligned, base_tt_hosp, method = "bilinear")
  pop_aligned_hosp <- mask(pop_aligned_hosp, base_tt_hosp)
} else {
  pop_aligned_hosp <- mask(pop_aligned, base_tt_hosp)
}

tab_hosp <- pop_by_tt_band(base_tt_hosp, pop_aligned_hosp, tt_breaks, tt_labels)

cat("\n=== Baseline travel time to HOSPITALS only ===\n")
cat("Total population:", format(sum(tab_hosp$pop_count), big.mark = ","), "\n\n")
print(tab_hosp)
```

## Combined summary table
```{r}
tab_combined <- rbind(
  cbind(scenario = "All facilities",  tab_all),
  cbind(scenario = "Hospitals only",  tab_hosp)
)

cat("\n=== Combined summary ===\n")
print(tab_combined)
```
